title: Fable-5 Is Finally Back
description:
Anthropic has officially brought Fable-5 back online. The model now includes additional safeguards and can switch to Opus 4.8 for specific coding and cybersecurity requests.

Here's what changed, why it matters, and what users can expect from the latest release.
